last.verdict: Moderna swung to a profit on 29% revenue growth and raised its 2026 outlook, but much of the cash jump is borrowed.

takeaways.label: Outlook raised
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue growth is now expected at 15–25%, up from 'up to 10%'. Q3 revenue rose 29% to $1.3B, mostly from international COVID vaccine deliveries.

takeaways.label: Cash boost is borrowed
takeaways.text: Year-end cash is now seen at $8.1–8.3B, up from $4.7–5.2B. About $2.6B of the rise is net proceeds from a $3.0B convertible note sale.

takeaways.label: Profit is seasonal
takeaways.text: Net income was $162M versus a $200M loss a year ago. Nine-month loss is still $1.96B, and most Q3 sales were not yet collected.

takeaways.label: Melanoma data lead pipeline
takeaways.text: The melanoma cancer vaccine with Merck cut recurrence or death risk 42% in Phase 3, and filings are being prepared. The norovirus vaccine's path forward is unclear.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
